lantern.name: Vesper's Lantern
lantern.effect: Fireball fires 2 additional projectiles. Fireball costs 50% more mana.

cinders.name: Crown of Cinders
cinders.effect: Burning enemies explode when they die, dealing 20% of their life as fire damage nearby.

saint.name: Shroud of the Drowned Saint
saint.effect: When your barrier breaks, enemies within 3 tiles are frozen. 5s cooldown.

bell.name: The Tolling Bell
bell.effect: Chain Lightning chains 3 more times but deals 30% less damage.

emberheart.name: Ember Heart
emberheart.effect: Cold skills deal 30% of their damage as extra fire damage and can burn.

gravewhisper.name: Gravewhisper
gravewhisper.effect: Hits against shocked enemies deal 25% extra cold damage.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller's Band
stormcaller.effect: Meteor releases a Static Nova where it lands.

hollowreed.name: The Hollow Reed
hollowreed.effect: Frost Bolt fires 1 additional projectile and pierces 2 more enemies.

tidecrook.name: Crook of the Last Tide
tidecrook.effect: Ice Nova and Static Nova have 40% larger radius and deal 25% more damage.

lamplighter.name: Veil of the Lamplighter
lamplighter.effect: +100% barrier recharge rate. Barrier from items is 30% higher.

tallow.name: Robe of the Tallow Saint
tallow.effect: Killing a monster restores 3% of your maximum life.

ninthbell.name: Gravecloth of the Ninth Bell
ninthbell.effect: +8% elemental damage reduction. The damage reduction cap rises to 40%.

choireye.name: Eye of the Sunken Choir
choireye.effect: Your hits penetrate 12% of all elemental resistances.

oathbreaker.name: Oathbreaker's Loop
oathbreaker.effect: +1 to all skill trees. -15% to all resistances.

pyrewright.name: Pyrewright's Rod
pyrewright.effect: Your hits deal 20% more damage for each ailment on the target (burning, chilled or frozen, shocked).

unburied.name: Mantle of the Unburied
unburied.effect: When you would die, you keep 20% of your life instead, become untouchable for 2 seconds and your barrier refills. Once every 60 seconds.

stair.name: Seal of the Endless Stair
stair.effect: Each kill grants +3% cast speed for 8 seconds (up to 10 times) and restores 2% of your maximum barrier.
